lessons.title: Approach to the Undifferentiated Emergency Patient
lessons.summary: กรอบคิดสำหรับผู้ป่วยที่ยังไม่รู้ diagnosis: scene → primary survey → resuscitation → focused differential → reassessment.

sections.title: 1) Stabilize before naming the disease
paragraphs: Emergency care เริ่มจากการหาสิ่งที่ฆ่าคนไข้ได้ในนาทีแรก ไม่ใช่การหาชื่อโรคให้สวยที่สุด. ใช้ ABCDE/XABCDE, monitor, glucose และ targeted bedside information เพื่อจัดลำดับปัญหา.
bullets: Treat immediately reversible threats while assessment continues
Abnormal physiology often matters more than diagnosis in the first minutes

sections.title: 2) Primary survey
paragraphs: A: patency/protection. B: work of breathing, oxygenation, ventilation. C: perfusion, pulse, BP, bleeding. D: consciousness, pupils, glucose, focal deficit. E: expose enough to find threats while preventing heat loss.
bullets: A normal single vital sign does not exclude serious illness

sections.title: 3) Build a dangerous differential
paragraphs: ใช้ complaint + physiology + risk factors สร้าง differential ที่ครอบคลุม immediately life-threatening causes ก่อน เช่น chest pain → ACS, aortic syndrome, PE, tension pneumothorax, tamponade, esophageal rupture.
bullets: Ask what finding would change destination or treatment now

sections.title: 4) Reassessment is a diagnostic tool
paragraphs: Trend HR, BP, RR, mental status, SpO₂, EtCO₂, pain and response to treatment. การเปลี่ยนแปลงหลัง intervention ช่วยบอกทั้ง severity และ diagnosis.

prehospital_focus: Scene safety and early destination decision
Call for additional resources early when physiology is unstable
red_flags: Severe work of breathing or silent chest

quiz.q: สิ่งใดควรมาก่อนในผู้ป่วยยังไม่ทราบ diagnosis?
options: Primary survey and treatment of immediate threats

lessons.title: High-Yield History & Focused Examination
lessons.summary: การซักประวัติและตรวจร่างกายแบบที่ช่วยตัดสินใจ ไม่ใช่เก็บข้อมูลทุกอย่าง.

sections.title: 1) History frameworks
paragraphs: SAMPLE ใช้ภาพรวม; OPQRST ใช้อาการ; medication/allergy/anticoagulant/insulin/last known well/last meal มีผลต่อการรักษา.
bullets: Clarify baseline function and mental status
Use collateral history when patient cannot answer

sections.title: 2) Focused exam
paragraphs: ตรวจเพื่อหา discriminating findings: symmetry, perfusion, lung sounds, neuro deficit, skin, edema, abdominal rigidity, bleeding, trauma pattern.

sections.title: 3) Context changes risk
paragraphs: Age, pregnancy, immunosuppression, renal disease, anticoagulation, recent surgery, cancer and substance exposure change pretest probability.

sections.title: 4) Communicate succinctly
paragraphs: Summarize problem representation: age + key risk + syndrome + severity + most important positives/negatives.

lessons.title: Emergency Triage & Resource Thinking
lessons.summary: หลักคิด triage: ใครต้องช่วยเดี๋ยวนี้ ใครมี high-risk physiology และใครต้องใช้ทรัพยากรมาก.

sections.title: 1) Triage is prioritization
paragraphs: Triage ไม่ใช่ diagnosis. จุดประสงค์คือระบุ immediate life-saving intervention, high-risk situation, altered mental status/severe distress และคาด resource needs.

sections.title: 2) Red flags
paragraphs: Airway threat, severe respiratory distress, shock, active major hemorrhage, seizure, severe AMS, STEMI/OMI concern, stroke syndrome, obstetric hemorrhage และ pediatric poor appearance ต้องขึ้น priority.

sections.title: 3) Re-triage
paragraphs: ผู้ป่วยรอสามารถ deteriorate ได้ จึงต้องมี trigger สำหรับ repeat vitals/reassessment.

lessons.title: Pain, Agitation & Procedural Sedation Principles
lessons.summary: เข้าใจ pain/agitation แบบ physiologic และใช้ sedation อย่างปลอดภัย.

sections.title: 1) Treat cause and suffering
paragraphs: Pain, hypoxia, hypercapnia, hypoglycemia, withdrawal, delirium and intracranial pathology can all look like agitation. Correct reversible physiology first.

sections.title: 2) Analgesia before sedation
paragraphs: When pain is a major driver, analgesia-first strategies may reduce sedative requirements. Dose choices depend on protocol, hemodynamics and airway risk.

sections.title: 3) Sedation is an airway procedure
paragraphs: Any sedative can produce loss of airway tone, hypoventilation or hypotension. Prepare suction, oxygen, BVM, monitoring and rescue plan before giving medication.

sections.title: 4) Monitor
paragraphs: Use repeated consciousness, RR, SpO₂, BP and capnography when appropriate; document effect and adverse events.

lessons.title: Geriatric Emergency: Atypical Presentation & Frailty
lessons.summary: ผู้สูงอายุมี physiologic reserve ต่ำและมักแสดงอาการไม่คลาสสิก.

sections.title: 1) Why presentation differs
paragraphs: Blunted fever/tachycardia, polypharmacy, sensory impairment and baseline cognitive disease can mask severity. Falls may be symptom of infection, arrhythmia, bleeding or stroke.

sections.title: 2) Medication hazards
paragraphs: Anticoagulants, beta-blockers, diuretics, insulin, sedatives and anticholinergics frequently alter presentation and risk.

sections.title: 3) Delirium is acute organ dysfunction
paragraphs: New confusion should trigger evaluation for infection, hypoxia, metabolic disturbance, medication toxicity, pain, urinary retention and intracranial disease.

sections.title: 4) Functional baseline matters
paragraphs: Ask baseline cognition, mobility, ADL, goals of care and recent change.
